resolution: Only current native-attested descriptors with observed-dead previous processes may keep their address. Explicit tombstone/supersedes remains retired; reopened native context needs a fresh address without oldqueue inheritance. No new field/schema. Daemon owns HTTP/SQLite, runtime actual chooser+realFS, PM final real CLI.
question: Does same-native cold resume include already explicitly tombstoned predecessors, or only current native-attested descriptors whose previous process is dead?
evidence: Automatic liveness reads leave native_extension_delivery true and the dead ProcIdentity on untombstoned descriptors.
Explicit tombstone and supersedes clear native_extension_delivery; migration0013 forbids a true flag on a tombstoned row.
Fresh-native dead-pane retirement using existing tombstone semantics also clears that provenance; state/session text alone cannot prove prior native attestation.
current_scope: Proven-dead current native-attested rebind and stale native occupancy retirement. Explicit retired/withdrawn rows remain ineligible for old-address recovery; no state/session-only inference or gate-policy change.
